cim: Artificial intelligence in the service of political calculations: The voice of a deceased journalist is misused
kihagyva: P3: 51 pont, tendencia 20%, jóváhagyás után fordul
cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence in the service of political calculations: The voice of a deceased journalist is misused
szoveg_eredeti:
Instead of political programs and arguments, accusations, manipulations, and content aimed at compromising those targeted by the campaign were used. One such example is the TikTok video directed against representatives of the Student List, in which, with the help of artificial intelligence, the voice of the deceased Montenegrin journalist Esad Krčić was misused.

Social networks were once again one of the main platforms for political showdowns and discrediting ahead of the recent elections in Serbia.

Instead of political programs and arguments, accusations, manipulations, and content aimed at compromising those targeted by the campaign were deployed. One such example is a TikTok video directed against a representative of the Student List, in which, with the help of artificial intelligence, the voice of the deceased Montenegrin journalist Esad Krčić was misused.

What did that campaign look like and what is hidden behind this way of political action?

prioritas.indok: Egy elhunyt újságíró hangját használták fel AI-val a montenegrói választási kampányban, de ez egy lokális politikai visszaélés. Forrás-tapasztalat: -6. A forrás P3-as híreiből eddig kb. 20%-ot fogadtál el.
prioritas.cim_hu: Elhunyt újságíró AI-val generált hangjával kampányoltak Montenegróban
prioritas.lead_hu: A montenegrói választási kampányban a TikTokon terjedt egy videó, amelyben mesterséges intelligenciával visszaélve Esad Krčić elhunyt újságíró hangját használták fel politikai lejáratásra.
